## Description

The first Audit event after startup or settings-cache expiry is currently dropped, even when export is enabled. This change will keep a bounded event batch during the existing settings read, bind it to the enabled revision returned by that read, and retain fresh authorization before export.

## Review

Draft — implementation and validation are in progress. The initial acceptance tests fail on the existing implementation, confirming the startup and expiry regressions. No merge or deployment is requested.

The completed PR will include updated plan and runtime documentation, regression evidence, quality checks, and the final review tier.
